title: "O4 Language distance (distals) — exploratory"
format: html
params:
  stage2_variant: "linear"
  fit_distance_models: true
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(glue)
library(here)
library(brms)
library(cmdstanr)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
iso_project <- read_csv(here("data", "language_distance_lookup.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
iso_exposure <- read_csv(here("data", "exposure_language_to_iso.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(key_lc = str_to_lower(str_trim(exposure_language)))

normalize_exposure_key <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(str_replace_all(as.character(x), "[\u000b]", ""))
  str_to_lower(x)
}

iso_from_exposure <- function(x) {
  k <- normalize_exposure_key(x)
  iso_exposure$iso_639_3[match(k, iso_exposure$key_lc)]
}

iso_from_project_language <- function(x) {
  iso_project$iso_639_3[match(x, iso_project$project_language)]
}

df_demogs <- readRDS(here("data", "demographics.rds"))

lang_long <- df_demogs |>
  mutate(data_id = as.character(data_id)) |>
  filter(map(languages, nrow) > 1) |> 
  unnest(languages) |>
  filter(!is.na(exposure_language), !is.na(exposure_proportion)) |>
  dplyr::select(data_id, exposure_language, exposure_proportion) |>
  mutate(
    key_lc = normalize_exposure_key(exposure_language),
    iso_el = iso_from_exposure(exposure_language)
  )

child_data <- readRDS(here("data", "bilingual_hirt_stage2_data.rds")) |>
  filter(!is.na(theta_est))

child_o4 <- child_data |>
  filter(age >= 7) |>
  mutate(
    exposure_proportion = exposure_proportion / 100,
    exp_c = scale(exposure_proportion, scale = FALSE)[, 1],
    age_c = scale(age, scale = FALSE)[, 1],
    iso_target = iso_from_project_language(language),
    key_el = normalize_exposure_key(exposure_language)
  )

counter_iso <- map2_chr(child_o4$data_id, child_o4$key_el, \(d, k) {
  cand <- lang_long |>
    filter(.data$data_id == d, key_lc != k)

  if (nrow(cand) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  mx <- max(cand$exposure_proportion, na.rm = TRUE)
  cand |>
    filter(exposure_proportion == mx) |>
    arrange(exposure_language) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    pull(iso_el)
})

child_o4 <- child_o4 |> mutate(iso_other = counter_iso)

pair_tbl <- child_o4 |>
  filter(!is.na(iso_target), !is.na(iso_other)) |>
  mutate(
    iso_a = pmin(iso_target, iso_other),
    iso_b = pmax(iso_target, iso_other)
  ) |>
  distinct(iso_a, iso_b)

pair_tbl |> nrow()

child_o4 |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    missing_target_iso = sum(is.na(iso_target)),
    missing_other_iso = sum(is.na(iso_other))
  )
```

Export unique ISO pairs for **distals** lookup ([Bitbucket](https://bitbucket.org/robvanderg/distals/src/master/)): distances are **precomputed** in the DistaLs database — run [`scripts/distals_pairwise.py`](scripts/distals_pairwise.py) after `pip install distals` (database caches under `~/.cache/distals/`).

```{r}
pairs_file <- here("data", "language_pairs_for_distals.txt")

pair_tbl |>
  mutate(line = glue("{iso_a},{iso_b}")) |>
  dplyr::pull(line) |>
  unique() |>
  write_lines(pairs_file)

head(readLines(pairs_file), 10)
```

```{r}
## DistaLs uses -1 when a distance cannot be computed (missing features / threshold).
dist_sentinel_na <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  v[!is.na(v) & v == -1] <- NA_real_
  v
}

dist_csv <- here("data", "language_pair_distances.csv")
if (file.exists(dist_csv)) {
  dist_wide <- read_csv(dist_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(across(
      any_of(c("lang2vec", "grambank", "glot_tree", "asjp")),
      dist_sentinel_na
    ))
  print(dist_wide |> head())
} else {
  dist_wide <- NULL
  message("Create ", dist_csv, " via scripts/distals_pairwise.py pairs_file -> CSV columns iso_a, iso_b, lang2vec, grambank, glot_tree, asjp")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(dist_wide) && nrow(dist_wide) > 0) {
  dist_join <- dist_wide |>
    mutate(
      iso_lo = pmin(iso_a, iso_b),
      iso_hi = pmax(iso_a, iso_b)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iso_lo, iso_hi, lang2vec, grambank, glot_tree, asjp) |>
    distinct(iso_lo, iso_hi, .keep_all = TRUE)

  child_o4 <- child_o4 |>
    mutate(
      iso_lo = pmin(iso_target, iso_other),
      iso_hi = pmax(iso_target, iso_other)
    ) |>
    left_join(dist_join, by = c("iso_lo", "iso_hi"))

  centre_vec <- function(v) {
    if (all(is.na(v))) {
      return(rep(NA_real_, length(v)))
    }
    v - mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  child_o4 <- child_o4 |>
    mutate(
      lang2vec_c = centre_vec(lang2vec),
      grambank_c = centre_vec(grambank),
      glot_tree_c = centre_vec(glot_tree),
      asjp_c = centre_vec(asjp)
    )
}
```

# Models (one metric at a time)

```{r eval=params$fit_distance_models}
if (!("lang2vec_c" %in% names(child_o4)) || all(is.na(child_o4$lang2vec_c))) {
  stop("Need merged distances (language_pair_distances.csv)")
}

metrics <- c("lang2vec_c", "grambank_c", "glot_tree_c", "asjp_c")

mod_all <- map(metrics, \(m) {
  f <- as.formula(glue(
    "theta_est | mi(theta_se) ~ age_c * exp_c * {m} + ",
    "(1 | child_id) + (age_c * exp_c | dataset_name * language)"
  ))

  fit <- brm(
    f,
    data = child_o4,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = c(
      prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
      prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
      prior(exponential(1), class = sd)
    ),
    save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    chains = 4,
    iter = 2000,
    cores = 4,
    seed = 126,
    threads = threading(2)
  )

  saveRDS(fit, here("models", glue("stage2_o4_{m}.rds")))
  
  fit
})
```

```{r}
map(mod_all, summary)
```

baseline <- readRDS(here(

fixef(baseline)
